villagemaster/31755.htm.text: Grand Magister Halaster: The Town of Goddard has produced many brave war heroes over the years, but it is also well-regarded as a center of learning and study. Do not underestimate these people simply because they live in a relatively wild and untamed region. In fact, the harsher their lives become…
